name: SKU Pruning Agent
reads: Converts physical volume, scrap, overtime & multi-modal freight into P&L margin impact Connected CPG systems: SAP IBP · DMS · Retail POS.
does: Optimizes inventory buffers (DSI) vs. supplier payment terms (DPO) in Mathematical Optimization Solver (MILP / CP-SAT) (Mathematical Optimization Solver (MILP / CP-SAT) Stochastic Cash-Conversion-Cycle (DSI + DSO - DPO) Optimizer + BigQuery Real-Time Margin & COGS Bridge).
returns: Scores ocean-to-air mode shifts vs. customer SLA penalties in net NPV rupees Stages policy-checked action via Joint CSCO–CFO Scenario Sign-Off, Dynamic Discounting Trigger & Working-Capital Budget Lock in Enterprise ERP (MCP / On-Prem DB).
stops_at: Never commits unapproved SAP IBP ledger mutations or overrides safety/contract policy without human sign-off.
